items.summary: As of 23 November, corporate bond issuances through private placements had already touched ₹7.16 trillion in FY27, according to Prime Database. With over four months remaining in the financial year, borrowing may reach or even surpass the previous record of ₹11.03 trillion, achieved in FY25.

items.summary: Schaeffler AG is reportedly planning to sell a 6% stake in Schaeffler India through a block deal worth about ₹3,188 crore, at a 5.6% discount to the previous close. The proposed sale comes as the stock extends its decline, despite strong September-quarter profit and revenue growth.

items.title: SEBI eases KYC norms, centralises supplementary client data to simplify onboarding
items.summary: SEBI has revealed new measures aimed at simplifying the client onboarding process for investors. By centralising supplementary KYC details with KYC Registration Agencies, investors can avoid repetition. The revised framework will take effect on December 24, 2026, enhancing efficiency in data management. Intermediaries are instructed to report account closures promptly to maintain accurate KYC records. Investors are also advised against engaging with grey market premium figures for IPOs.

items.title: Sebi mulls early payout of up to 80% of sale proceeds to FPOs in commodity derivatives market
items.summary: Sebi introduced a proposal for an early pay-out framework designed to assist Farmer Producer Organisations. This framework would allow FPOs to access up to 80 percent of sale proceeds before contract expiry. The initiative aims to alleviate liquidity challenges by providing timely payments to farmers. Corporate trading members will offer this facility based on certain conditions and net worth requirements. Public comments on the proposal are invited until December 16.

items.title: Who is Indu Swaroop, new CFO of Canara HSBC Life Insurance, taking over after Tarun Rustagi's resignation?
items.summary: Indu Swaroop is a founding member of Canara HSBC Life Insurance and has been associated with the company since 2008. Before his elevation as CFO, he served as its Financial Controller, supporting the CFO and overseeing several critical aspects of the company's finance function.

items.title: RBI may opt for 25 bps rate hike as oil eases, inflation risks persist: Baroda BNP Paribas MF CIO
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is projected to implement a 0.25 percent interest rate hike in December. While decreasing crude oil prices could alleviate some inflation worries, many senior executives advocate for a measured strategy due to the prevailing economic climate. Nevertheless, concerns regarding food inflation and supply chain issues persist, adversely influencing overall forecasts.

items.title: Regional Air Connectivity Fund gets income-tax exemption for four years till FY30
items.summary: The Income Tax Department has granted a tax exemption status for the Regional Air Connectivity Fund Trust. This exemption applies for four tax years, up to FY30, under specific conditions outlined by the CBDT. It aims to support airlines operating on underserved regional routes through viability gap funding initiatives. Compliance with regulations is necessary to retain this exemption, as non-compliance may incur penalties.

items.summary: Deutsche Bank and Punjab National Bank have signed a preliminary agreement to structure and finance corporate acquisitions in India, following RBI reforms allowing domestic lenders to fund up to 75% of acquisition deal values. The partnership will combine PNB's domestic network with Deutsche Bank's global capabilities to support Indian companies' expansion plans.

items.title: US Treasury gains lift India bonds ahead of RBI meet
items.summary: On Wednesday, Indian government bonds rallied, influenced by a decrease in US Treasury yields. The benchmark 10-year bond yield fell to 7.1641%, marking a two-week low. The Indian rupee strengthened to its highest level for the fiscal year against the dollar. Overseas investors returned as net buyers of Indian debt, purchasing over 93 billion rupees. The Reserve Bank of India's upcoming decision will significantly affect market movements and trends.

items.title: GTRI urges CBIC to issue guidelines to resolve Scotch whisky classification issue
items.summary: GTRI has requested the Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs to provide guidelines for Scotch whisky classification. There is an ongoing dispute concerning customs duties under the India-UK Comprehensive Economic Trade Agreement. Current classification issues may significantly increase import duties from 75 percent back to 150 percent. Importers are urged to adhere to internationally recognized classifications and established court precedents.

items.summary: The PLI Scheme for the Automobile and Auto Component Industry has disbursed Rs 4,385.28 crore in the current financial year. Cumulative disbursements under this scheme have reached Rs 6,771.64 crore since its inception. Approved applicants reported investments surpassing the target by achieving Rs 52,806 crore by September 2026. The scheme has generated 77,755 employment opportunities and facilitated incremental sales of Rs 82,993 crore.

items.title: Fed policymakers at odds over causes of high inflation
items.summary: US inflation is expected to increase again in October, with potential implications for Federal Reserve interest rate decisions. Economists predict the Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index to reach 3.8% this month. Analysts are divided regarding whether inflation is caused by demand or supply shocks stemming from recent policies. Market forecasts suggest three more rate hikes, signaling ongoing concerns about rising prices.

He claims that Tata Trusts are obstructing the public offering for their own benefit and breaching regulations. Meanwhile, the Reserve Bank of India has pressured Tata Sons to meet listing necessities.

items.title: Ahead of FY27 budget, aluminium industry seeks import duty hike on primary metal, scraps, finished products
items.summary: In a pre-budget proposal to the government, the Aluminium Association of India (AAI) has sought an increase in the basic customs duty on primary aluminium and the metal scraps to 10 per cent, and the levy on downstream product imports to 15 per cent, arguing that these measures would significantly reduce forex losses and strengthen the domestic industry.

items.title: PhonePe resumes IPO process; targets February-March listing at $12-15 billion valuation
items.summary: PhonePe has resumed its initial public offering plans after deferring them due to market uncertainties. The company aims for a stock market listing valued between USD 12-15 billion in early 2024. It expects to raise approximately Rs 12,000-14,000 crore through an offer-for-sale. The digital payments firm has also reported significant revenue growth and is now profitable at the group level.

items.title: PepsiCo India to invest Rs 868 cr in Tamil Nadu to set up food manufacturing facility
items.summary: PepsiCo is set to invest Rs 868 crore in a greenfield food manufacturing facility located in Tamil Nadu. This new facility is expected to begin commercial operations by July 2028 and will enhance PepsiCo's manufacturing capabilities. It will focus on producing popular brands like Lay's and Kurkure to better serve South Indian markets. Additionally, the company aims to expand agricultural partnerships with local farmers for potato cultivation.

items.title: Foxconn blames Indian vendor for contractual breach as USD 15 mn dispute reaches NCLT

The dispute involves approximately $15 million in alleged dues owed to BCD Emprassa by Foxconn. Additionally, the claim includes around 700 residential units leased to accommodate employees. Foxconn indicated that it will pursue legal action to protect its interests in this matter.

items.summary: Britain's Financial Conduct Authority has issued guidance for technology firms regarding AI agents and financial services. Firms must assess if their AI capabilities involve regulated activities and consult with regulators accordingly. This advisory follows Meta's launch of its Muse personal AI agent capable of several financial tasks. Moreover, users should be aware of the protections available to them while using these AI agents.

items.title: Mumbai ranks last in top 10 preferred real estate cross-border investment destinations in APAC: Colliers
items.summary: Mumbai has been identified as the least preferred city for cross-border real estate investment in Asia-Pacific. According to the Colliers report, Tokyo leads the rankings followed by Osaka and Sydney. Melbourne and Fukuoka have tied for the fourth position, while Singapore and Brisbane are also favored. Colliers emphasises the potential for long-term growth and the influence of infrastructure developments in Mumbai.

items.title: Why France is at risk of recession — and what could keep it out of one
items.summary: Bank of France Governor Emmanuel Moulin told CNBC he still expects growth, pointing to resilience in sectors including defense, aerospace and electricity.

items.title: States raise ₹7 trillion in market borrowings so far in FY27, 12% below plan
items.summary: Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal and Karnataka account for nearly 62% of the increase in state borrowings, even as the Centre has trimmed its own FY27 borrowing programme.

items.title: Jensen Huang is ‘too big to fire,’ putting Nvidia’s governance in focus: analysts
items.summary: Jensen Huang’s return has underscored Nvidia’s deep reliance on its founder, putting the company's board oversight and corporate governance under scrutiny.

items.title: Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang
items.summary: Nvidia had come under pressure from President Trump to reappoint Huang, whose comeback helped add $1tn to the company's stock value.

items.title: India, Canada 'very close' to conclude trade pact negotiations: Official
items.summary: Negotiators from India and Canada are engaging daily to finalize the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement negotiations. A sixth round of discussions took place recently, focusing on key areas such as trade and investment. Both countries aim to increase bilateral trade to USD 50 billion by 2030, after a decline in trade values. India is also working on a separate bilateral investment protection agreement with Canada.

items.title: Compass reignites City exodus fears
items.summary: Catering company is latest heavyweight to plan New York shift as groups seek to boost liquidity and valuations

items.title: India-EU free trade pact to open new opportunities for trade, investment: German state leader
items.summary: India and the European Union concluded negotiations on a Free Trade Agreement that is set to be finalized soon. Minister-President Olaf Lies of Lower Saxony emphasized the potential benefits for both Indian and German businesses. He mentioned cooperation in areas like digitalization and artificial intelligence as key prospects for collaboration. The partnership aims to enhance skilled workforce mobility with training programs for young Indians.

items.title: More credit, but large gaps: the challenge ahead for Mudra and Stand-Up India push
items.summary: Five-year extensions for Mudra guarantees and Stand-Up India keep small-business credit flowing, but existing credit gap, skewed beneficiary shares, rising loan sizes, and repayment stress raise tough questions on inclusive growth.

items.title: China has changed tactics but is still thwarting India's rise, a U.S. panel says
items.summary: China is increasingly focused on containing India economically rather than through military actions.

items.title: The shake-up facing renters as a new kind of landlord emerges
items.summary: Companies building flats that they then rent out could usher in big changes for renters.

items.summary: The breeder's rating was downgraded but he continued to advertise as five-star, investigation finds.

items.summary: More powerful artificial intelligence models are raising expectations for more powerful on-device chips that can run on devices from robots to smartphones.

items.title: Nvidia value climbs by almost $1tn and tech stocks rally after Jensen Huang returns
items.summary: The jump in Nvidia shares has also lifted stock markets, with the tech-heavy Nasdaq up 6.5%.

items.title: India-UK trade deal cuts Scotch whisky duty to 75%, but bulk imports face 110% levy; govt working to resolve dispute
items.summary: The issue concerns high-strength bulk spirit imported from the UK for dilution, blending and bottling in India, rather than bottled Scotch whisky sold directly to consumers.

items.title: India, UK working to resolve technical glitch over Scotch whisky duty concessions under trade pact
items.summary: The Commerce Ministry is working with the Finance Ministry, importers and UK authorities to resolve a customs classification issue affecting duty concessions on Scotch whisky imports under the India-UK trade pact. Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agarwal said India remains committed to its tariff obligations and has urged the DRI to release pending consignments.

items.title: RBI Governor asks NBFCs, housing finance firms to bolster cyber defences
items.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra called on non-banking finance companies and housing finance companies to bolster cybersecurity measures. He emphasized the importance of a comprehensive, risk-based approach to managing cyber threats. Malhotra also highlighted the necessity for responsible credit growth and customer prioritization within these financial institutions. Participants exchanged feedback on policy and operational aspects affecting the NBFC sector during the meeting.

items.title: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?
items.summary: The Nvidia chief executive has been at the centre of the artificial intelligence boom.

items.title: Deepak Parekh flags missing housing starts data in India's economic indicators
items.summary: Deepak Parekh addressed the Data Users Conference highlighting the lack of official housing start data in India. He emphasized that this data is crucial due to strong linkages with many allied industries. Parekh noted the recent revision of the GDP base year to 2022-23 and its implications for economic indicators. He also mentioned the importance of high-frequency indicators in assessing economic trends beyond quarterly GDP figures.

items.title: 26-year-old Google worker earns $323,000 a year—but lives on less than minimum wage
items.summary: Charles Broomfield set a post-college goal of reaching $750,000 in investments by age 30. Now 26, he expects to get there within the next year.

items.title: Fertilizer subsidy may rise 15% to ₹2.5 trillion even as sales fall 8%
items.summary: India’s fertilizer subsidy bill could rise 15% to ₹2.5 trillion in FY27, near its record high, as global prices climb despite weaker demand. Fertilizer sales fell 8% in April-October, while deficient monsoon rains are expected to reduce annual consumption to 65-67 million tonnes.

items.title: India weighs 20% export duty on select rice varieties to boost domestic supply
items.summary: India is contemplating the imposition of export duties on specific rice varieties to improve domestic supplies. This measure aims to mitigate rising prices faced by consumers and industries in the local market. Although the export duty might slow rice exports, it is unlikely to halt shipments completely due to competitive pricing. The poultry and cattle feed sectors have been notably affected by the surge in broken rice prices.
